The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
digest.tldr: Concerns are being raised that neither the Commerce Department nor Nvidia are doing their due diligence when it comes to vetting Chinese firms cleared to handle the company's H200 AI chips.

digest.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
digest.tldr: Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI.  And it appears to be working remarkably well, with the company's models improving roughly twice as quickly as a year ago, with little indication of slowing down.
